1  Ms. Arti Prasad, Adv.
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R

The petitioner is accused for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 354 & 376 of the Indian Penal Code and 18:01:28 IST Reason:
Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
He apprehends his arrest and his anticipatory bail application was dismissed by the High Court.
Being aggrieved, the petitioner approached this Court and vide order dated 01.07.2024 interim protection was granted to the petitioner by this Court.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, State and the respondent no.2.
We have been informed by the learned counsel for the State that charge sheet has already been filed.
Under these circumstances, we are of the opinion that the order dated 01.07.2024 granting interim protection to the petitioner is made absolute.
Accordingly, in the event of the arrest of the petitioner, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail forthwith on the usual terms and conditions to be decided by the concerned Court.
The present petition shall stand disposed of in the above terms along with pending application(s), if any.

(NIRMALA NEGI) (RENU BALA GAMBHIR)
COURT MASTER (SH) COURT MASTER (NSH)
